svg.title: Five layers of the approach, and the ledger beside every one
svg.text: Five layers, and the ledger beside every one.
Whatever a layer does is an event on the ledger first; the CBOM, the register, the plan and the pages are rebuilt from it.
an isolated scanner on a desktop
the same layers on an x86_64 server with its models behind one seam, and once on a desktop GPU box with the network cut
